stories.headline: Macron announces new aircraft carrier will be named 'France Libre'
stories.summary: President Macron visited Naval Group near Nantes on March 18 to announce the name of France's next nuclear-powered aircraft carrier as 'France Libre' (Free France), honoring the WWII resistance movement. The announcement came during a visit to the construction site where work on the €10 billion project has begun.

stories.headline: Macron announces mediation to salvage European fighter jet program
stories.summary: President Macron announced on March 19 a mediation effort to save the troubled FCAS European fighter jet program with Germany and Spain. The project has stalled due to disagreements between France's Dassault and Germany's Airbus, with Chancellor Merz agreeing to the mediation mission.

stories.headline: Renoir exhibitions open at Musée d'Orsay
